name: Puerto Rico
standard: Ley 229-2003 (as amended) plus PRITS 'Guías de Accesibilidad de la Ley 229'; ADA Title II floor (WCAG 2.1 AA)

laws.cite: Ley Núm. 229 de 2 de septiembre de 2003 (Ley para Garantizar el Acceso de Información a las Personas con Impedimentos)
laws.summary: Requires web pages and electronic transactions of Puerto Rico government agencies, public corporations and municipalities to be accessible to people with disabilities, with complaints to the disability ombudsman and fines up to $2,500.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: Guías de Accesibilidad de la Ley 229 para Páginas Web de Agencias del Gobierno de Puerto Rico (PRITS)
accesibilidad.pr.gov (reporting form and GUIDI design guidelines)

applies_to: All Puerto Rico government agencies, departments, public corporations and municipalities with websites.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Pages designed for assistive technology, with information in alternative formats
Follow PRITS Ley 229 guidelines (mandatory 'TIENE' items: lang, titles, headings, links, tables, lists, and more)
mobile: implied — PRITS's form covers government 'portales y aplicaciones'; Ley 229 predates apps; the federal rule covers them.
enforcement: Complaints to the Defensoría de las Personas con Impedimentos (fines up to $2,500 per violation); accessibility form at accesibilidad.pr.gov run by PRITS and DPI; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: The claim that OGP/OPPI/PRITS guidelines require 'WCAG 2.1 AA' comes from search extracts (PRATP) and was not in the opened texts. Municipalities with population under 50,000 get the 2028-04-26 federal date; the Commonwealth itself gets 2027-04-26.
